title: Order submission timeout & connection pool exhaustion
description: Order processing queue latency escalated sharply and checkout requests are failing with database connection acquisition errors.

hypotheses.name: Incorrect payment endpoint
hypotheses.description: Payment endpoint routing table is misconfigured.
hypotheses.recommended_action: Audit service mesh routing and DNS resolution for payment endpoint.

hypotheses.name: Payment provider outage
hypotheses.recommended_action: Check external processor SLA status and engage merchant support.

hypotheses.name: Database failure
hypotheses.description: Database connection pool exhausted or queries blocking transactions.
hypotheses.recommended_action: Identify and terminate long-running blocked database queries, cycle saturated connection pool instances, and review database max_connections limit.

evidence.observation: HikariPool-1 connection acquisition timeout: 30000ms elapsed with 0 free connections.
External provider webhook callbacks and status pings respond in 45ms.
